apps.localizedDescription:
Hydra is a native client for browsing Reddit and the ultimate experience on iOS. It is fast, fluid, and designed to make browsing Reddit natural and intuitive.

This build is distributed by an independent third party not related to the upstream Hydra project.

Crafted with a native iOS design, Hydra feels right at home on your iPhone and iPad. It loads fast, responds instantly, and makes reading and participating in discussions effortless.

Features:

• Fast loading for browsing feeds and media.

• Native iOS design and gesture-driven navigation.
• Integrated image and video viewer with inline playback.
• Split view and multi-column support on iPad.
• Quick swipe gestures to upvote, downvote, reply, and collapse comments.
• Markdown formatting for posts and comments.
• System share integration to export links, media, and comments as images.

versions.localizedDescription:
What's Changed in Upstream Hydra:

Built from upstream commit df845c9 on master.

🔄 Commits Since App Store Release (v4.3.0)::

• 91a40cb Add optional feed vote buttons and vote tap haptics (#71).
• ae01460 vote button ui refinement.
• 98e4590 Add the comment count to the post details (#72).

• ba07295 new api.
• fc1ee9e add login button to pages that get not logged in error.
• 81b5741 update info.
• df845c9 post and comment message previews sometimes rendered links incorrectly.

Features:

• Mute videos by default.

• Hide next comment button.
• Hide popular & all.
• Disable inbox replies.
• Media viewer performance.

Bugfixes:

• The login page could sometimes freeze or report a browser error, causing login to fail.
• The audio track on videos could stutter after rotating the device.
• Pan gestures on zoomed in images would sometimes be counted as a tap by the media viewer overlay.
• Text bodies in spoiler posts would sometimes not be blurred correctly.
• In certain cases, Hydra would fail to indicate when a user is banned.
• Certain gestures would cause Hydra to crash after backgrounding the app.
